name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.23: allow-list clear_device_owner, console only and deliberately without a dashboard button. Surrendering Device Owner is a one-way door on a placed machine — silent over-the-air updates end permanently and every later build needs someone on site with adb — so a command needed once in a machines lifetime does not earn a button a stray click could reach. Two guards that cannot be satisfied by a careless paste: params.confirm must be exactly the string yes, and params.deviceCode must match the machine being addressed, so a command copied from one machine to another is refused rather than stranding the wrong one. Issuing it raises a critical alert and emails the operator, because a mistake here should be heard about immediately rather than discovered at the next update. Cumulative over v6.22.
